title: Click attacks land more often
changes: Melee swings now forgive the network delay: if the monster was in reach on your screen, the hit counts even if it just stepped away.
Your hero no longer swings from a spot it hasn't really reached yet (for example right after being knocked back).
Arrows, fireballs and thrown weapons are aimed where a walking monster is going, not where it was. Big monsters are also easier to hit with them.
Monsters hiding in a tree or grave can't be clicked anymore, so you no longer swing at one that can't be hurt.
